authority: Owner asked to continue on 2026-09-18 after API knowledge completion and the explicit next step of persistent assumptions/provisional beam review. The September 10 assume-and-continue decision and prepared U1-U5/R01-R12 plan govern this milestone.
objective: Complete the snapshot-to-persistent-assumptions-to-provisional-review-to-edit-refresh/reopen/report loop with visible provenance and unchanged strict full-design meaning.
bounded_units: U1 field and scenario contracts, complete field/consumer/fallback matrix and a named example
U2 pure resolver and versioned persistence/migration with scoped overrides and source isolation
U3 independent core/provisional coordinator using existing qualified calculations and complete member/stage accounting
U4 Excel assumptions/detail views, automatic coalesced review, cancellation/ownership and early owned-host smoke
U5 integrated R01-R12 acceptance, exact signed installed artifact, cumulative correctness gate, one candidate/PR cycle

acceptance_rows.scenario: Open the owned snapshot with all supplemental fields blank
acceptance_rows.outcome: Finish review with zero questions/acceptance dialogs; every consumed field has a visible effective value/rule or named example basis.

acceptance_rows.scenario: Remove material mappings, supports and SLS roles separately
acceptance_rows.outcome: Preserve source gaps, persist scenario assumptions, evaluate supported independent work and retain unavailable checks.

acceptance_rows.scenario: Change cover, fck/fy, bars, links and stock
acceptance_rows.outcome: Typed requests and all affected actual-bar/depth/check outputs reflect edits; inherited versus explicit overrides is visible. A changed hash alone is insufficient.

acceptance_rows.scenario: Blank, invalid, formula or conflicting scoped input
acceptance_rows.outcome: Preserve entered text/alternatives; select the deterministic valid fallback without executing formula text or displaying a blocking prompt.

acceptance_rows.scenario: Required 60-minute fire, nonzero unsupported actions and missing service evidence
acceptance_rows.outcome: Preserve each known requirement/action and distinct check status. Full-design readiness cannot be upgraded by the provisional overlay.

acceptance_rows.scenario: Mixed supported, unsupported, no-fit and injected calculation failure
acceptance_rows.outcome: Complete peers and produce one outcome for every selected member; no invented check or omitted denominator.

acceptance_rows.scenario: Reopen twice, then use a different model with repeated member/material IDs
acceptance_rows.outcome: Persist edits and effective origins; reuse only valid project preferences; regenerate source-specific assumptions and historical/current identities.

acceptance_rows.scenario: Edit during computation, switch workbook, close workbook and cancel
acceptance_rows.outcome: Discard obsolete completions, coalesce refresh, preserve initiating-workbook ownership and honor cancellation. Owned Excel exits after harness cleanup.

acceptance_rows.scenario: Missing external snapshot/result or disconnected ETABS
acceptance_rows.outcome: Complete a truthful review with available/example/unavailable entries. No claim of successful live acquisition, analysis or save.

acceptance_rows.scenario: Change only rates, then edit a section/scenario
acceptance_rows.outcome: Refresh compatible costs from the same quantities; analysis-affecting alternatives retain unverified status until D. Unsupported future stages still appear in the review.

acceptance_rows.scenario: Existing explicit-input full-design fixture and old saved workbook
acceptance_rows.outcome: Preserve complete-design meaning, source/currentness guards and required checks; migrate without resetting edits or altering immutable prior evidence.

acceptance_rows.scenario: Real ribbon path on exact signed candidate
acceptance_rows.outcome: Final installed receipt binds source/package/workbook/fixture hashes and every R-row, including zero prompts and actual request-value changes. Development smoke is not final acceptance.

non_goals: New engineering formulas or expanded action/section/support profiles; route these to C0c
New live ETABS capture methods, setters, model mutation or analysis
Optimization/overnight orchestration, issued reports, public package publication or PF9 performance certification
Modify user Excel/ETABS sessions, models or the original checkout edit
likely_pitfalls: Treating fire/SLS-unavailable as NotApplicable or erasing nonzero actions to pass the mapper
Two independent assumption/catalogue values that change hashes but not actual requests
Losing explicit-equal-default edit provenance or cross-model override isolation
Using synthetic/example actions as source evidence
Stale async completions, repeated auto-refresh after cancellation, or writing to the active rather than initiating workbook
Claiming installed acceptance from a build/development smoke or skipping newly added tests
Concurrent writes during formatter scope snapshots; finish documentation first

verification.per_unit: Only affected focused native/host tests and diagnostics that guide current implementation; independently inspect actual request values and retained WP11 outputs.
verification.cumulative_gate: U5: full native and Windows suites, broad Python suite and full 32-check run after content stabilizes; exact signed owned-Excel R01-R12 acceptance; one immutable candidate review/integrity and required hosted PR cycle.
verification.final_receipt_contract: Aggregate exact source/tree/XLL/manifest/fixture/workbook identities, new signed review acceptance including legacy migration and R01-R12, strict signed baseline regression, cumulative suites and candidate audit/integrity. No development smoke can satisfy the signed gate.

writer_lane: One parent in isolated Windows codex/beam-provisional-review; retained source/installed evidence reused within exact scope.
implementation_status: U1-U4 integrated; U5 frozen-candidate gates remain authoritative externally
